Caddy R33 reproducible build record
===================================

Runtime version:
  v2.11.4-r33-go1.26.5

Upstream source:
  https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy
  tag: v2.11.4
  commit: e2eee6a7fce366321294c9c2a79f3146891dcbdf

Toolchain:
  Go 1.26.5
  CGO_ENABLED=0
  GOOS=linux
  GOARCH=amd64 or arm64

Exact module graph:
  Copy Caddy-go.mod to the upstream source root as go.mod.
  Copy Caddy-go.sum to the upstream source root as go.sum.

Security dependency updates relative to upstream v2.11.4 include:
  github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 v5.3.0
  github.com/klauspost/compress v1.18.7
  go.opentelemetry.io/otel v1.44.0
  go.opentelemetry.io/otel/metric v1.44.0
  go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace v1.44.0
  golang.org/x/crypto v0.54.0
  golang.org/x/net v0.56.0
  golang.org/x/text v0.40.0
  google.golang.org/grpc v1.82.1

Build command (replace ARCH with amd64 or arm64):
  GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.5 CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=ARCH \
    go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false \
    -ldflags='-s -w -buildid= -X github.com/caddyserver/caddy/v2.CustomVersion=v2.11.4-r33-go1.26.5' \
    -o caddy_linux_ARCH ./cmd/caddy

SHA-256:
  amd64  2d9683d8520210cc5b85a4af1f7b23295c812a7868c98a942601dbe1e7e48760
  arm64  3b6c50d7bb13a46a2973e0eca5f029bd01d18670dc522edc68e59bb5f45c3159

Reproducibility:
  A second amd64 build from the same source, module files, toolchain and flags
  produced the identical SHA-256 shown above (byte-for-byte cmp exit 0).

Validation:
  go test ./cmd/caddy ./caddyconfig/caddyfile ./modules/caddyhttp
  passed with Go 1.26.5.

Vulnerability audit:
  All advisories with available fixed dependency versions were removed.
  govulncheck -mode=binary reports only GO-2026-5932 for
  golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp. The advisory has no fixed version, and
  `go list -deps ./cmd/caddy` does not contain the openpgp package, so the
  executable command dependency graph has no reachable import of that package.
